base_ribs.scope: ribs join base walls/bosses; local bearing excludes tail-window openings

service_sequence: remove cartridges, unplug console and remove upper shell
hold both dust leaves of the serviced slot at 90 degrees for top-driver access
support console upside down to hold the four exterior socket-anchor nuts; loosen socket bolts only when needed
unplug harnesses and undo remaining base/module fasteners before lifting PCB/socket/frame module for solder-side work
reinstall metal floor bushings and exterior washers; verify full nut engagement, foot clearance and grip/tolerance condition before powering

cartridge_cover.scope: nominal split cover, hard stops and axial capture; ABS strength/tolerance not released

selected_load_cases_not_standards.description: illustrative fore/aft force; opposite direction and lateral X remain separate checks

upper_carrier_ideal_bay.limits: continuous full flanges and simply supported bay; local holes, sheet buckling, joints and ABS compliance omitted

lower_spreader_local_socket_ear_strip.limits: Historical intact 10 mm span comparison used to select 2.0 mm plate. The actual A04 flange relief removes these local ABS rib supports. Direct flanged steel bushes now support the socket ears; this strip result is not a current A04 stress or deflection prediction.

compression_sleeve_gross_section.limits: gross metal compression only; no socket plastic bearing or fastener proof

lateral_moment.limits: illustrative rigid-body reaction only; gap take-up, torsion and actual load sharing not resolved

unproved: connector housing and contact load distribution
cartridge ABS retention stops and threaded bosses
base ABS ribs, floor and wall joints including creep/fatigue
fastener grade, preload, thread pullout and weld schedule
integral floor-bushing flange and external washer contact/bending including mold floor-thickness variation
minimum bolt-tip clearance to the supporting table at compressed-foot and bolt-length tolerance extremes

selected_steel.source_scope: current primary material specification: 0.40-3.00 mm stock and 340-420 MPa yield; not proof of a particular supplier brand in 1995
selected_steel.scope: upper 1.0 mm carrier and lower 2.0 mm plate; coating and weld procedure remain to be qualified

lower_plate_A03_comparison.scope: Historical same-span material-thickness comparison only: same intact net strip, 150 N and 10 mm span. A04 floor-anchor rib relief removes that actual local support; no assembly performance is inferred.

base_washer_gross_bearing.limits: Effective ABS bearing annulus excludes the actual 6.8 mm floor hole, not merely the 3.4 mm washer hole. Average contact pressure only; no ABS allowable or creep/fatigue conclusion. Nonuniform contact, ring bending, gross floor flexure and tolerances remain unqualified.

proof_test_plan.condition: 150 N axial push and pull on either slot; repeat with both carts fitted
proof_test_plan.measure: socket and floor displacement, force-displacement, local ring/floor contact, bolt/nut retention, PCB strain and solder integrity before/after; both push and pull
proof_test_plan.acceptance_proposal: no cracking/loosening/electrical interruption; residual slot offset <=0.2 mm; final acceptablePCBstrain per actual components

proof_test_plan.condition: 30 N forward/back/left/right at cart top,109.4 mm above console datum
proof_test_plan.acceptance_proposal: no permanent damage or contact interruption; maximum live displacement criterion set from connector drawing

proof_test_plan.condition: 5000 insert/remove cycles at selected connector rated force, elevated temperature corner included
proof_test_plan.measure: contact resistance, insertion force, screw retention and capturedPCB stops
proof_test_plan.acceptance_proposal: selected connector and solder-joint limits;5000 is a project objective, not an asserted standard

extraction_load_path_scope.old_A03_path: socket ear -> bolt head -> tension bolt -> nut under lower steel plate -> flat lower plate -> frame posts/anchors -> ABS base/feet
extraction_load_path_scope.actual_A04_push_path: socket -> upper sleeve -> lower spreader -> flanged steel floor bushing -> interior flange -> ABS floor
extraction_load_path_scope.actual_A04_pull_path: socket -> bolt -> exterior M3 nut -> OD14 exterior washer -> ABS floor
extraction_load_path_scope.metal_preload_path: socket/sleeve/spreader/bushing/washer/nut; nominal floor grip equals ABS thickness but tolerances may create preload or clearance
extraction_load_path_scope.status: Four implemented local floor anchors close the push and pull paths. Gross demands are calculated; assembled strength, stiffness and preload remain unqualified.
extraction_load_path_scope.reason: Unilateral ABS rib contacts cannot resist upward tension. Flange rib clearances also invalidate the previous local 10 mm push-strip support.

socket_floor_bushing_gross_section.limits: Gross local metal compression only; flange bending, bushing length stability, bearing distribution, socket ear and floor deformation omitted.

floor_perimeter_shear_demand.limits: Illustrative nominal demand along an ideal OD14 cylindrical perimeter. It is not a punching-shear capacity model for injection-molded ABS and is not compared with a resin allowable.

integral_flange_radial_strip_comparator.limits: Illustrative independently bending radial strips with uniformly distributed floor reaction, fixed at the bus OD. Circumferential plate coupling, joint radius, nonuniform ABS contact, external washer/nut contact and floor flexibility are omitted. Not FEA, not a guaranteed upper bound, and not structural acceptance.

A04_lower_spreader.production_gate: Forming/welding, notch stresses, plastic bearing and complete assembly abuse testing remain unqualified.

A04_shutters.scope: Real separate leaves, pins, guide-wall pockets and hinge bearings. Torsion-coil space reserved; spring legs/anchors, compliance, force curve and life are not released.

A04_socket_floor_anchors.push_path: socket -> upper sleeve -> lower spreader -> flanged steel floor bushing -> interior flange -> ABS floor
A04_socket_floor_anchors.pull_path: socket -> bolt -> exterior M3 nut -> OD14 exterior washer -> ABS floor
A04_socket_floor_anchors.metal_preload_path: socket/sleeve/spreader/bushing/washer/nut; nominal floor grip equals ABS thickness but tolerances may create preload or clearance
limits: ABS floor punching, creep, flange/washer bending and joints need prototype qualification.
Local rib relief removes the old 10 mm strip support assumption at each socket ear; use direct support model.
Selected screw length must be procured or trimmed, deburred and gauge checked; not silently treated as a standard stocked length.
Minimum foot clearance must be checked with fastener tolerances and foot compression.
A04_socket_floor_anchors.material_requirement: steel minimum yield 340 MPa; integral turned bushing and stamped washer procurement, final grade/process qualification required
